data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'atos' (father) and 'wekko' (throng, multitude), Atwekk can be interpreted as 'father of the multitude' or 'father of the people'. This name carries a strong sense of leadership and nurturing, evoking images of a wise and caring patriarch. The name Atwekk carries the meaning “Father of the Throng” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atwekk usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the throng and live with faith, good character and purpose.
